posts.title: Betamax Anniversary: 1975-2026
posts.description: Although this site is primary dedicated to audio recording technologies, it’s important to remember that many video recording technologies also record audio. The original Betamax system, which Sony introduced May 10, 1975, had a single, monophonic sound track, recorded alongside the video and sync tracks.
